metadata.notes: Added 2026-08-16, alongside fill.json/heat_place.json — the second half of ROADMAP.md's 'no FILL/PLACE verb' gap. Deliberately does NOT transform the placed instance's own state/tags (outputs: {} — no transformedState) — being physically located in a place is orthogonal to being cooked; a later BOIL/SIMMER/FRY step against the same instance still does the actual cooking transition, exactly as it did before this action existed. What this DOES do, handled specially by src/recipe-runner.ts (not via engine.ts's applyAction): record co-location in a runner-local placeContents map, the concrete mechanism behind boil.json/simmer.json's own 'two ingredients in the same pot share one heat' gap.
metadata.placementMethodNote: Same parameter/allowedValues as boil.json's/simmer.json's identically-named placementMethod (see those files' own placementMethodNote for the full three-mechanism crack-risk reasoning) — promoted here to the action that actually models the physical moment of entry into the vessel, rather than being informational-only on the LATER cooking action. boil.json/simmer.json keep their own placementMethod parameter unchanged for recipes that don't use PLACE_IN at all — this isn't a replacement, it's the same real fact recordable at the more physically accurate step for recipes that DO use places.
metadata.sequencingNote: PLACE_IN before HEAT_PLACE vs. HEAT_PLACE before PLACE_IN is now literally boil.json's startMethod distinction (cold_start vs. boiling_start) made expressible as real step ORDER for the first time, not just an informational parameter string — see scripts/ for a capability test proving both orders against the identical place/heat mechanism.

verification.description: The instance is physically inside the named vessel — a camera or a human confirms it, no sensor threshold applies.

hazards.note: If the place already contains hot/boiling medium (a HEAT_PLACE step ran first), lowering something into it carries the same splash/scald risk as BOIL/SIMMER — see boil.json's placementMethod for the real, cited mitigation techniques this parameter records.
